org.name: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency

hazard: Lack of fire hazard warnings on product packaging
theme: Community health care and emergency services related deaths

reports.title: Pauline Taylor
categories: Community health care and emergency services related deaths
Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: We aim to have completed our review by the end of 2017 and will consider the need for publication of any additional safety advice at this time in conjunction with our medicine colleagues.
promises.summary: Complete review of emollient safety advice by end of 2017

promises.quote: PAGB and its member companies recognise that clear information needs to be made available to warn of the risk of increased flammability of clothing and bedding which has been in contact with paraffin-containing emollients.
promises.summary: Develop clear warning statements on packaging

concerns.quote: Zerobase and other emollient creams which contain a low level of paraffin pose a potential fire hazard risk
concerns.hazard: low level of paraffin in emollient creams

concerns.quote: Warnings of such risks are not displayed on all product packaging
concerns.hazard: lack of fire hazard warnings on product packaging

concerns.quote: Health care professionals both in a hospital and community setting may not be aware of the potential fire hazard posed by emollient creams which contain a low level of paraffin
concerns.hazard: lack of awareness among health care professionals

concerns.quote: Members of the public are able to purchase emollient creams across the counter but are not verbally made aware of the potential fire hazards of emollient cream containing a low level of paraffin
concerns.hazard: lack of verbal warning to public

concerns.quote: Private companies who provide carers in the community do not receive alerts with regard to medicines and medical devices which could impact on the risk assessments and the manner in which carers working in the private sector provide care
concerns.hazard: lack of alerts to private care providers

concerns.quote: Care homes (in both the local authority and private sector) who provide residential/nursing care may not be aware of the potential fire hazard risk of emollient creams which contain low levels of paraffin
concerns.hazard: lack of awareness in care homes

reports.title: Brian Bicat
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: e Paraffin based ointments and emollient creams which contain a low level of paraffin pose a potential fire hazard risk
concerns.hazard: paraffin based ointments and emollient creams fire hazard

concerns.quote: e Warnings of such risks are not displayed on all product packaging
concerns.hazard: lack of fire hazard warnings on product packaging

concerns.quote: e Health care professionals in both hospital and community setting may not be aware of the potential fire hazard poised by emollient creams which contain a low level of paraffin
concerns.hazard: lack of awareness among healthcare professionals about fire risk of emollients

concerns.quote: e To consider fire warning labelling on all emollients including those below 50% content, making clear the mechanisms of the risk
concerns.hazard: inadequate fire warning labelling on low paraffin emollients

concerns.quote: e Health care professionals including pharmacists to verbalize product warnings at the point of prescription, dispensing or point of sale
concerns.hazard: lack of verbal warnings at point of care

concerns.quote: e Members of the public are able to purchase such products in retail outlets and online where verbal warnings from healthcare professionals are not given
concerns.hazard: public exposure to fire risk without professional guidance

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that warnings about the fire‑hazard risk of paraffin‑containing emollient creams are missing from product packaging. They refer to the same specific hazard and the same mechanism of risk.
links.earlier_quote: (2) Warnings of such risks are not displayed on all product packaging.
links.later_quote: e Warnings of such risks are not displayed on all product packaging
links.promise_quote: PAGB and its member companies recognise that clear information needs to be made available to warn of the risk of increased flammability of clothing and bedding which has been in contact with paraffin-containing emollients.

followups.summary: The organisation did not state a completion date for the promised action.
